en: Black‑and‑white image of a very large, ornate dining hall or hotel restaurant. The hall features high coffered ceilings with elaborate moldings, several enormous decorative chandeliers, and a two‑level gallery with balustrades running along the sides. Tables covered with white cloths and wooden chairs are neatly arranged in rows, with ice buckets or similar metal containers on many tables. Large windows with draped curtains line the walls, and decorative columns support the upper gallery. The image is framed with a white border, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
